result.meaning: Readback of service state and configuration validation; an inactive service or invalid configuration can be a successful observation.

active.meaning: Whether systemctl is-active exited zero and returned active.

status.meaning: Activity derived from the same probe.

details.meaning: Stripped concatenation of systemctl status stdout and stderr.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Present on a stop refusal; no mutation occurred.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class if the shared front door had to report an unhandled exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed outcomes are listed below; none means the observation completed. The stop also returns command failed: <argv>: <error> when a command cannot run.
